assumptions: Unupgraded production and Extractors at five seconds; the intended lab consumes one of each required core per synchronized tick.
Single-core chain tables are isolated production references. Full research requires all types simultaneously at the lab tick rate; minimum illustrative rate is one complete set per minute.
Water intakes modeled at four units/second; upgrades can reduce intake count.
No recycling credits, electricity, logistics, renewable forestry or deposit replacement in raw or node totals.
Fractional totals represent average batch consumption, not fractional individual item movements.

pricingPolicy.principle: Affordable capability unlocks; escalating optional efficiency and quality-of-life investments. Equal quantities of all required cores remain mandatory.
pricingPolicy.scope: Sample proposed projects only. Existing live research costs are unchanged.
pricingPolicy.dependencyRule: An optional efficiency or quality-of-life upgrade must not be required merely to access the next core tier.

frameworkResearch.name: Factory Templates
frameworkResearch.effect: Paid core research for saved layouts and batch placement previews; existing duplicate controls remain available.

frameworkResearch.name: Hydro Processor 1
frameworkResearch.effect: Hydro Processor cycles use 90% of base time; ingredient quantities and yields stay unchanged.

frameworkResearch.name: Advanced Assembler 1
frameworkResearch.effect: Advanced Assembler cycles use 90% of base time.

frameworkResearch.name: Power Distribution
frameworkResearch.effect: Dedicated Power Conduits carry 25 existing power units per second, without single-unit cable particles or a change in generation yield.

frameworkResearch.name: Tree Planter 1
frameworkResearch.effect: Tree Planter cycles use 90% of base time; each growth unit still consumes five power units.

frameworkResearch.name: Research Center 2
frameworkResearch.effect: Research Center cycle uses 80% of base time; replaces the 90% factor rather than multiplying it.

frameworkResearch.name: Mineral Recovery 1
frameworkResearch.effect: Slag washing and recovered Brick/Iron recipes take 10% less time after any applicable family modifier; no extra material recovery.

frameworkResearch.name: Warehouse Logistics
frameworkResearch.effect: Dedicated one-item Warehouse holds 250 items with a filtered outlet; Inventory retrieval stays a later unlock.

frameworkResearch.name: Road Channels 1
frameworkResearch.effect: Allows two one-way Road channels per direction. Each transfers its sending Wooden Chest contents instantly at an interval; cadence, capacity and full-destination behavior remain open.

frameworkResearch.name: Hydro Processor 2
frameworkResearch.effect: Hydro Processor cycles use 80% of base time, replacing the 90% factor.

frameworkResearch.name: Advanced Assembler 2
frameworkResearch.effect: Advanced Assembler cycles use 80% of base time, replacing the 90% factor.

frameworkResearch.name: Area Expansion 2
frameworkResearch.effect: Field dimensions use a 1.5 multiplier over tier-scaled base dimensions, replacing 1.25.

frameworkResearch.name: Resource Golem Survey
frameworkResearch.effect: Reveals eligible midgame Iron, Copper, Mythril and Stone Golem encounters. Defeating one creates a permanent infinite multi-output mineral anchor; health, counts, ports and delivery rates remain open.

frameworkResearch.name: Mineral Regeneration
frameworkResearch.effect: Proposed base recovery of one unit per 30 seconds in ordinary non-wood deposits, up to capacity. Empty deposits remain to regenerate after this unlock; existing Big Holes do not become deposits.

frameworkResearch.name: Mineral Regeneration 2
frameworkResearch.effect: Proposed base regeneration improves to one unit per 15 seconds and opens indefinitely repeatable rate research. This replaces the earlier automated-drill proposal.

frameworkResearch.name: Road Channels 2
frameworkResearch.effect: Allows four one-way Road channels per direction; preserves sending-chest batches rather than continuous global transport.

repeatableResearch.name: Mineral Regeneration Rate
repeatableResearch.effect: Each rank adds 20% of the post-Regeneration-2 base regeneration rate; no maximum rank.

repeatableResearch.name: Storage Placement Capacity
repeatableResearch.effect: Each rank adds one Storage placement to the global cap; no maximum rank.

repeatableResearch.name: Inventory Placement Capacity
repeatableResearch.effect: Each rank adds one Inventory placement to the global cap; no maximum rank.

repeatableResearch.name: Storage Connection Capacity
repeatableResearch.effect: Each rank adds one permitted connection per Storage; no maximum rank.

repeatableResearch.name: Inventory Connection Capacity
repeatableResearch.effect: Each rank adds one permitted output connection per Inventory; Inventory still initially connects only to Filters.

repeatableResearch.name: Global Pool Item Capacity
repeatableResearch.effect: Indefinitely increases per-item limits in the one global transfer pool. Starting limits and capacity gains remain open.

endgameResearch.name: Automatic Inventory Selection
endgameResearch.effect: Proposed research gate for exact-input-port selection, allowing a direct Inventory connection to a configured machine. Filters remain available. Research versus world-condition gate is still open.

endgameResearch.name: Monster Node Assault
endgameResearch.effect: Proposed access/targeting preparation for tier-10 Monster Nodes. Research does not defeat them; factory-supplied combat does. Encounter counts and delivery requirements remain open.

recalculation.goal: Perfect play completes all existing fixed research and all 29 proposed fixed projects through tier 6 within 10800 seconds. Optional repeatable ranks, tier-7 projects, Map Node repeats and combat manufacture are additional.

expansion.note: Uses richest map capacities first plus Home, ignoring adjacency, map-research materials and recycling. This is an optimistic bound, not a travel route.
expansion.noteOnSurveyGrants: Earlier free-survey suggestion is no longer necessary to repair lab time after correcting synchronized research. Map progression remains open under D16.

buffering.idealReservoirCalculation: Not specified; size for route batch size, travel and safety margin, not the number of core types.
buffering.note: Research consumes one of each required core in the same tick. All required types must sustain one per tick; reservoirs absorb transport jitter but cannot divide the required production rate by the number of types.
